_readme: Family band templates (v6). Common base kit/lib/style-spec.mjs → BASE_BAND; Here, only the differences are written and a deep merge is performed. New band = registration here + seamless range in kit/families.json.

oyun.radiusRule: Vertex is either 0 or single small value (≤6px); smooth 12px+ rounding is prohibited.
oyun.colorNote: HUD contrast: status colors (live/damage) are derived from the accent's tones; A fourth hue is not added.
oyun.typeNote: Numbers are taboos; score/timer areas are mono and right aligned. Title in uppercase, body in sentence order.
oyun.gridNote: The screen grid acts like a visible frame: a 1px accent border is placed between sections, no decorative lines are added.
oyun.surfaceNote: Surfaces are opaque; There is no glass/blur. Thin accent edge is used for status notification.
oyun.hierarchy: Primary focus is on one big number/score; second focus single CTA; the rest is label.

dress.icons: 1px block icon, 16/20px canvas; no anti-alias, integer scale
dress.photos: In-game rendering or single object shooting; 25% area, dark vignette
dress.illustration: Sprite/silhouette: up to 3 tones (accent, ink, surface-2)
dress.texture: Static raster (1px/3px, 4%) on section background only
dress.logo: Top left 20px, uppercase, mono or display

oyun.essenceTail: gaming aesthetic whose interface acts like a control panel, without sacrificing readability
notThis: Neon is not a ubiquitous theme; accent carries only case and action.
Dark background alone does not make a play style; Numerical rhythm and sharp corners are required.
Pixel font is not mandatory; software HUDs are also in this family.
oyun.origin: The screen typography tradition of arcade cockpits, console HUDs, and PC game menus; After the 2010s, it became simpler with live broadcast and esports interfaces.
recognition: Is the Accent number unique or used for the situation?
screens: Score + status bar + single CTA; No overlays of more than 3 layers
Vertical list, accent left edge on selected row, 44px row
Grid 4-pack, rarity tag mono on each card
Right aligned numbers, hairline instead of zebra
3 column plan card, accent edge in the middle
Single column 480px, label 12px mono on top
traps: The interface looks like a toy
Reduce Accent to 14% fill, reset shadow
Keep uppercase in title, change body to sentence order
extraBans: Infinite blinking indicator (no animation in v6).

operasyon.radiusRule: Corner 4–6px; Soft rounding above 8px contradicts the operational picture.
operasyon.sectionYnote: Dense display: section spacing 44px, line rhythm 40px.
operasyon.colorNote: Status colors are not derived from accent, but come from separate semantic tokens (--ok/--danger/--warn); accent is the action color.
operasyon.typeNote: Dense display: 14px body, 13px table, 10.5px mono label. The line height cannot be lower than 1.55.
operasyon.gridNote: 8 columns of content + 4 columns of panels; tables full width. In-card padding 16px, line 40px.
operasyon.surfaceNote: Surfaces are smooth; separation with 1px edge and background tone. Reference line in graphs --line.

dress.icons: 1.5px line, 16px box; full of status icons
dress.photos: There is no photo on the data screen; single illustration in empty case

operasyon.essenceTail: It is an operation interface that reads data in line rhythm without embellishing it.
notThis: It is not a dashboard template; each block answers a decision question.
Dark theme is not mandatory; Contrast and intensity are decisive.
operasyon.origin: The information-intensive tradition of NOC/SRE consoles, financial terminals and logistics operations displays.
recognition: Are the numbers right-aligned and taboo?
screens: 4 KPI + single time series; delta and time range on each KPI
Filter bar + 40px row + right aligned number
Form 2 column, unit label mono on right
One sentence + one button; no illustration
3 steps, single verification at each step
traps: The screen is crowded but empty
The number of KPIs is high
Set a limit of 4 KPIs per screen
Hairline instead of zebra; use color only for occasion

ticaret.radiusRule: Card 10–14px, button 6–10px; full circle only chip/badge.
ticaret.colorNote: Price and stock information is written with --ink, not accent; accent solo action (cart, buy).
ticaret.typeNote: Price 26–32px display, currency 13px mono; product name 15px/600.
ticaret.gridNote: Product grid 3–4 columns; card ratio 4:5. Filter rail 240px.
ticaret.surfaceNote: Cards are separated by light shadow; On hover, the shadow grows, the edge does not change.

dress.photos: The product is single object, white/neutral backdrop, shadow is soft; 4:5
dress.illustration: Thin line only in category title

ticaret.essenceTail: is a showcase language that highlights the product and clarifies the price and action
notThis: It is not a showcase poster; The product grid and price hierarchy are decisive.
Discount red is not used everywhere; One emphasis is enough.
ticaret.origin: The on-screen equivalent of printed catalogue, storefront and marketplace listing layouts.
recognition: Is the price eye in the first three seconds?
screens: 3–4 columns, 4:5 image, price + single line description
Gallery on the left, price + variant on the right
Row 64px, piece stepper, subtotal right aligned
traps: Reduce padding to 12px, increase image to 86% of card
Lower the shadow to one level, keep the badge single
extraBans: Stack of discount labels on price.
More than four types of rosettes.

kultur.radiusRule: Corner 0–4px; The language of culture is established with sharp edges and wide gaps.
kultur.colorNote: Ground paper tone; accent only link and program tag. The image's own color remains dominant.
kultur.typeNote: The title is large-scale and tightly spaced; body 17px, size 68ch. Label mono and uppercase.
kultur.gridNote: Wide margin (56px), asymmetric 7/5 column. Section titles remain in the left column.
kultur.surfaceNote: There is no shadow; distinction by hairline and ground tone. Images are in full-edge or 4:3 frame.

dress.photos: Exhibition/venue photography, natural light, wide angle

kultur.essenceTail: It is a cultural broadcast language that presents content like programs and archives, not like posters.
notThis: It is not a copy of the museum brochure; Screen readability is preserved.
Serifs are not required; space and scale are decisive.
kultur.origin: Typographic hierarchy of print program magazines, exhibition catalogs and theater posters.
recognition: Does the title span at least 3 lines?
Was hairline used instead of shadow?
screens: Date + venue + single CTA; mono label
Grid 3 columns, year and genre on each card
traps: The page is falling apart like a magazine
Select and keep single asymmetry rule

saglik.radiusRule: Corner 8–12px; form fields 10px. Sharp 0px corner remains harsh in clinical language.
saglik.colorNote: Trust color accent; Warning and error come from semantic tokens. Red is only for real risk.
saglik.typeNote: Body 16px/1.65 — reading fatigue is kept low. Labels 13px, form help text 12px.
saglik.gridNote: Form 2 columns (mobile 1), content 8 columns. 20px inside card; line spacing 44px.
saglik.surfaceNote: Card surface is opaque; soft shadow single level. Focus ring over 3:1 on any surface.

dress.icons: 1.5px line, 20px; neutral geometry instead of medical symbol
dress.photos: Natural light, people-oriented, no stethoscope cliche
dress.illustration: Single line, calm; no anatomical details

saglik.essenceTail: It is a healthcare interface that reduces anxiety and prioritizes readability and clarity of form.
notThis: It is not a hospital brochure; form and state flow are decisive.
Green is not mandatory; Contrast and calm rhythm are decisive.
saglik.origin: Accessibility practice of clinical forms, patient information materials, and healthcare applications.
recognition: Is the error message below the field?
screens: One message + one CTA + trust line
2 columns, label at the top, error at the bottom
saglik.defaultA11y: high — above AA, form errors programmatic

ogrenme.radiusRule: Card 14px, button 12px; Hot rolling is accepted in educational products, above 20px is prohibited.
ogrenme.colorNote: With the accent of progress and success; error semantics. Color alone does not carry status, icon/text is added.
ogrenme.typeNote: Header 50px, body 16px. Course titles 20px/600; duration tag mono 11px.
ogrenme.gridNote: Course cards 3 columns; progress bar 6px. Form 2 column.
ogrenme.surfaceNote: Cards are hot surface; shadow single level. Progress bar 6px, accent padding.

dress.photos: Learning moment, natural light; no stock pose

ogrenme.essenceTail: It is an educational interface that makes progress visible and divides learning into small steps.
notThis: It is not a children's application; The same language applies to adult learning.
Gamification is not about putting badges everywhere.
ogrenme.origin: The digital equivalent of the lesson plan, workbook, and progress chart tradition.
traps: Reduce the reward to a single indicator per week
Each screen is a single target

materyal.radiusRule: Corner 0–6px; The material edge remains sharp, soft rounding weakens the texture.
materyal.colorNote: Material color background: accent alone stamp/label. Build texture with grain and edges, not color.
materyal.typeNote: Title 52px/400 — remains silent next to the texture. Tags mono, wide tracking.
materyal.gridNote: Card spacing 14px; The material photo can extend right to the edge, the text cannot.
materyal.surfaceNote: Shadow single level; With material feeling grain + edge. No glass/blur.

dress.photos: Macro texture: paper, metal, fabric; soft side light

materyal.essenceTail: It is a printing language that makes the surface feel like material and balances texture with typography.
notThis: Adding cardboard texture is not style alone.
It is not skeuomorphism; There is texture, no imitation objects.
materyal.origin: Material information of letterpress, ink, paper and metal printing workshops.
recognition: Is the hood slim and quiet?
traps: Reduce to 4%, use only on large surface
Move text block to opaque surface
extraBans: Imitation object (stone that looks like a button).

tipografi.radiusRule: Corner 0px — in typographic essay, geometry serves the text.
tipografi.colorNote: Two colors are enough: ground and ink. Accent is just a word of connection and emphasis.
tipografi.typeNote: Display 72px, line spacing 0.98; body 16/1.6. There is no midpoint — the jumping between two extremes is intentional.
tipografi.gridNote: 12 columns are not visible; The title spans 8 columns, the body remains in 6 columns.
tipografi.surfaceNote: No shadows and rounding; The only difference is the hairline and space.

dress.photos: Only when necessary; supports text, does not compete
dress.illustration: Can be used as typographic sign

tipografi.essenceTail: It is the language that makes the letter itself a visual event and derives the ornament from typography.
notThis: A heading is not typographic style alone; A grid and measurement are also required.
It is not a pile of decorative fonts; One family is enough.
tipografi.origin: Experiments with Swiss typography, poster printing and editorial headlines.
recognition: Does the title span three lines?
Are there (shouldn't there be) more than two font families?

gelecek.radiusRule: Corner 2–8px; In speculative language, geometry is sharp, rounding is measured.
gelecek.colorNote: Accent is a signal color; It is used in lines, labels and graphics instead of wide background.
gelecek.typeNote: Display 54px; technical labels mono and wide tracking. Body 15px, size 62ch.
gelecek.gridNote: The grid is slightly visible as an auxiliary line (accent 8%); section spacing 56px.
gelecek.surfaceNote: The surfaces are separated by a thin accent edge; 1px signal line instead of shadow.

dress.photos: Technical visual: render, diagram, macro texture

gelecek.essenceTail: It is a language that highlights the language of measurement and system and describes the future with diagrams rather than ostentation.
notThis: Neon is not a sci-fi cliché; accent signal, ground calm.
Dark background is not mandatory; Contrast and line language are decisive.
gelecek.origin: The visual language of space program interfaces, laboratory instrument panels, and system diagrams.
recognition: Was Accent used as a signal?
traps: label on top of each other
